feeds.title: National Harm Reduction Coalition Blog
feeds.description: We are a handful of individual activists, educators, and people who used drugs and began launching grassroots efforts to support members of their communities who were dying from this brutal disease. Brought together by their love and compassion for people who use drugs, these individuals formed a small working group that became the start of the Harm Reduction movement. National Harm Reduction Coalition is committed to uplifting the voices and experiences of people who use drugs.

feeds.title: BMC Harm Reduction Journal
feeds.description: The Harm Reduction Journal publishes research and commentary on policies, strategies, programs, and practices that aim to reduce the adverse impact of behaviors, laws, and regulations on individuals and communities.

feeds.title: CATIE Blog » Harm Reduction
feeds.description: The CATIE Blog hosts the views and opinions of people and organizations working and volunteering in Canada's response to HIV and hepatitis C. Read informative articles on the website about harm reduction.

feeds.title: Clergy New Drug Policy Blog
feeds.description: The mission is to mobilize clergy nationally on behalf of an agenda that ends the War on Drugs by allocating resources to education, treatment, and public safety. News and policy updates related to ending the War on Drugs by allocating resources to education, treatment, and public safety. Clergy for a New Drug Policy mobilizes people of faith to end the War on Drugs and to seek a new paradigm for drug policy.

feeds.title: Harm Reduction Center Blog
feeds.description: Our goal as a provider is to empower and support your recovery. Harm Reduction Center is a private healthcare facility that provides highly individualized service to our clients, offering Integrated Medication Assisted Treatment and all outpatient levels of care. Harm Reduction Center utilizes proven effective treatment modalities such as MAT (Medication Assisted Treatment), EMDR & Trauma therapies, individual & group therapeutic interventions, and cooperative medical involvement.

feeds.title: NHHRC Blog
feeds.description: At New Hampshire Harm Reduction Coalition Our mission is to promote compassionate care for people who use drugs through harm reduction by supporting syringe service programs (SSPs), utilizing best practices, and advocating for human rights.

feeds.title: Beat Addiction Blog
feeds.description: Beating addiction is not an easy feat and almost inevitably requires professional help to do it successfully-moreover, ongoing support from family and friends is crucial as one begins their journey on the road to recovery. Stay up to date with our blog and read more on the many ways we can help on your road to recovery, we understand how hard it can be to beat your addiction.
